description: India-oriented baseline risk profile using established meteorological categories. Rainfall bands follow the India Meteorological Department daily rainfall classification; wind bands map Beaufort force 6+ (strong breeze) upward; heat bands follow IMD heat-wave awareness ranges. Treat every value as a configurable baseline, not immutable scientific truth.

rainfall_mm_per_day.note: IMD daily rainfall categories: large/heavy 35.6-64.4, very heavy 64.5-115.5, extremely heavy >=115.6

wind_kph.note: Beaufort 6 (strong breeze) ~39-49 kph, gale ~62-74, storm ~88+; converted from the 10.8/17.2/24.5 m/s baseline

us_aqi.note: US EPA AQI bands: Moderate >=51, Unhealthy for sensitive groups >=101, Unhealthy >=151; 201+ (Very Unhealthy) and 301+ (Hazardous) also map to EXTREME with deeper scores

rainfall.customer: Carry rain protection and plan indoor alternatives for the wettest hours.
rainfall.farmer: Schedule field work around the wettest hours; check drainage in low-lying plots.
rainfall.traveler: Expect wet roads and slower traffic; keep a rain cover for gear and documents.
rainfall.disaster_management_officer: Track rainfall against local drainage capacity; pre-position crews in low-lying wards.

high_temperature.customer: Limit strenuous outdoor activity and drink water regularly.
high_temperature.farmer: Shift heavy labor to early morning; ensure livestock and workers have shade and water.
high_temperature.traveler: Travel early or late in the day and keep water reachable.
high_temperature.disaster_management_officer: Issue heat advisories and verify cooling/water points are stocked.

heat_stress.customer: Avoid outdoor exertion in the afternoon and rest in shade; watch for dizziness or exhaustion.
heat_stress.farmer: Stop heavy field work in peak afternoon hours; rotate workers with shade breaks.
heat_stress.traveler: Avoid midday exertion; carry electrolytes and rest in shade often.
heat_stress.disaster_management_officer: Open heat-relief points and coordinate outreach to outdoor laborers.

strong_wind.customer: Secure loose outdoor items and be careful near trees and hoardings.
strong_wind.farmer: Delay spraying and staking work; secure temporary field structures.
strong_wind.traveler: Expect crosswinds on exposed roads and bridges; drive with both hands on the wheel.
strong_wind.disaster_management_officer: Warn about loose debris and roof damage; monitor for power line faults.

severe_weather.customer: Stay indoors away from windows; postpone outdoor plans until the storm passes.
severe_weather.farmer: Move people and animals to safe shelter; secure equipment before the storm arrives.
severe_weather.traveler: Do not travel during the storm; wait it out in a sturdy building.
severe_weather.disaster_management_officer: Activate monitoring cells and pre-position rapid-response teams.

flood_potential.customer: Avoid low-lying areas, underpasses and basements during heavy rain.
flood_potential.farmer: Clear field drainage channels; move stored produce above expected water levels.
flood_potential.traveler: Never drive or walk through water of unknown depth; plan alternate routes.
flood_potential.disaster_management_officer: Coordinate with irrigation/flood control; alert flood-prone settlements early.

poor_travel_conditions.customer: Allow extra travel time and check conditions before leaving.
poor_travel_conditions.farmer: Plan market trips outside the worst weather windows.
poor_travel_conditions.traveler: Reduce speed, use headlights, and expect delays on wet or windy stretches.
poor_travel_conditions.disaster_management_officer: Coordinate with traffic police on diversions for waterlogged or debris-strewn routes.

activity_disruption.customer: Have an indoor backup for outdoor events and errands.
activity_disruption.farmer: Reschedule harvesting, spraying or other time-critical field work.
activity_disruption.traveler: Expect cancellations or delays for outdoor activities; keep flexible bookings.
activity_disruption.disaster_management_officer: Assess which public events and worksites need postponement or evacuation support.

air_quality.customer: Air quality is poor, so limit outdoor exertion and keep windows closed during the worst hours.
air_quality.farmer: Schedule outdoor field work for cleaner-air hours; burning waste or stubble is not advised today.
air_quality.traveler: Expect hazy conditions; people with respiratory sensitivities should carry medication and limit exertion outdoors.
air_quality.disaster_management_officer: Monitor AQI against health-advisory thresholds; coordinate advisories for schools and outdoor work sites.
